info.title: Stash API Catalog
info.description: Machine-readable catalog of Stash HTTP surfaces. Full request/response details: https://stash.illo.fyi/openapi.json and https://stash.illo.fyi/llms.txt

endpoints.description: Decode a stash payload (the share-URL fragment value). Negotiate output with Accept: application/json | text/markdown | text/plain; fallback query param format=json|md|txt.
Resolve a 6-char base32 short id. Same negotiation rules as viewer-decode; without negotiation 302-redirects to the HTML viewer.
Create a short link from a list of URLs. Unauthenticated, rate-limited.
Revoke a short link before TTL expiry. Unauthenticated, rate-limited.
MCP Streamable-HTTP endpoint (stash_create, stash_get, stash_decode). ~60 req/min.
OpenAPI spec hosted on the shortener origin.

apis.name: profile-local-browser-agent
apis.description: For browser-class agents running inside the user's profile (ChromeClaw, NanoBrowser, BrowserOS). Not a fetch endpoint.

endpoints.description: Open in the browser, wait for data-stash-status="ready" on <pre id="agent-export">, read its text (canonical StashExport JSON). ?agent=markdown variant at <pre id="agent-export-md">.
